title: Missing items are reported at position 0
summary: `find_index(items, target)` should return the position of `target` in the list, or `-1` if it is not there. Right now `find_index([5, 6, 7], 99)` returns `0` instead of `-1`, so it looks like the item was found at the start.
hint: Think about what the function returns when the loop finishes without finding anything.
